requirement.description: The Tick, Delay, and other simulator command classes are missing proper async iteration protocol implementation for use in 'await' expressions. Tests are failing with TypeError: object Tick can't be used in 'await' expression.
requirement.contract: Simulator command classes (Tick, Delay, PosEdgeTrigger, NegEdgeTrigger, etc.) must implement proper async iteration protocol (__aiter__ and __anext__) to be compatible with await expressions in test scenarios. The classes should properly yield control to the async event loop rather than raising StopAsyncIteration immediately.

requirement.description: The Context class's posedge and negedge methods return inner classes that don't properly implement the async iteration protocol. Tests expect these to be awaitable objects but they raise StopAsyncIteration immediately.
requirement.contract: Inner trigger classes (PosEdgeTrigger, NegEdgeTrigger, ChangedTrigger) returned by Context.posedge(), Context.negedge(), and Context.changed() must properly implement async iteration protocol (__aiter__ and __anext__) to be compatible with await expressions in test scenarios.

requirement.description: BrokenTrigger class is referenced in tests but not properly defined or imported in the module. Tests are failing with NameError: name 'BrokenTrigger' is not defined.
requirement.contract: The BrokenTrigger class must be properly defined and exported from the sim module to be accessible to tests. The class should be defined at module level and added to __all__.

requirement.description: Some CRC tests are failing due to pickling issues with module objects. Tests are failing with TypeError: cannot pickle 'module' object.
requirement.contract: CRC-related classes and methods should not attempt to pickle module objects. The implementation should avoid serializing module references in ways that cause pickling errors.

requirement.description: The Context.sample() method attempts to access signal attributes that may not exist, causing AttributeError when accessing _init attribute on Slice objects.
requirement.contract: Context.sample() method must safely handle signal access without assuming presence of specific attributes like '_init'. It should gracefully handle missing attributes and provide fallback behavior.
